title: Building Blocks — Module Test
description: Test your knowledge of the whole module: Building Blocks. You need at least 6 out of 8 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use possessives, articles, plurals, and demonstratives in simple sentences.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Possessive Adjectives: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/g

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: The pen on the desk ___ blue.
questions.explanation: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article with plural g

questions.question: Complete: This ___ a pen.
questions.explanation: This/these = near the speaker. That/those = farther away. Match number: this/that + singular verb; these/those + plural verb.

questions.question: True or false: "This is my house." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.
